headline: Tesla Expands Into Vietnam as Competition Intensifies in China
summary: Tesla expands into Vietnam as its China EV market share falls to 6.6% and traders expect Q3 deliveries to decline year over year.

headline: Tesla Roadster Teaser Hides a 'Back to the Future' Easter Egg: Here's What it Says
summary: Tesla teases an Oct. 1 Roadster unveiling with a hidden Back to the Future reference, fueling speculation about SpaceX thrusters that could make it fly.
